environment.location: Doc Mercer's Underground Clinic (Washington Borough Catacombs)
environment.description: Ancient vaulted stone catacombs beneath Washington Avenue. Flickering cerulean mana-lamps cast long shadows over brass steam pistons, marrow-siphoning conduits, and surgical dissection tables. The air is tinged with distilled ether, alchemical bio-sealants, and cooling copper coils.

entities.name: Doc Mercer
entities.intent: Consult on biological graft surgery, anatomical integration, and trade medicinal tinctures.
